title: DeepSeekHarness: one-paste furnishing of a DeepSeek Harness workspace (memory, tutorial, one-click install, skills)
description: DeepSeekHarness furnishes a DeepSeek Harness workspace in one paste: a Git-native memory layer adapted from Mem-Forever, a beginner tutorial whose first move is reading the iLang runtime core, an approval-gated bootstrap that installs missing tools from official sources only, and a growing skill shelf. The user pastes one sentence and nods; the agent does the rest. Memory is plain Markdown with iLang declarations in the user's own Git repository: readable by people, parseable by machines, portable across tools, and every change ships as a versioned release.
